predicate.label: legal specialist in field
predicate.definition: Person X is explicitly identified as a legal expert or lawyer specializing in legal field or issue Y.
includes: explicit legal expert, authority, or specialist on Y
a legal-field modifier of a lawyer
ambiguous: lawyer title or field attachment unresolved
predicate.notes: Y is a legal subject, not the represented client. Expertise is textual attribution, not an independent credential evaluation.
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: lawyer specializing in Y; explicit legal expert, authority, or specialist on Y; a legal-field modifier of a lawyer. Excludes: client representation without specialization; generic institutional membership; practice location or ordinary employment; expertise in a nonlegal field. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear legal field versus client; lawyer title or field attachment unresolved. Y is a legal subject, not the represented client. Expertise is textual attribution, not an independent credential evaluation.

rationale: Explicit lawyer specializing/expert/authority in a legal field overwhelmingly dominates.
